case.pattern_description: 3 online purchases were made on this card inside 39.0 minutes, each amount parked just beneath the $200 authorisation ceiling (mean headroom 0.04%), totalling $599.79. The shape defeats per-transaction review because every individual leg looks ordinary; only the burst as a whole is anomalous. It was found by scanning the card's recent online activity for clusters concentrated immediately below round authorisation thresholds, and matches five confirmed-fraud closed cases (CC-3748, CC-3841, CC-3907, CC-4086, CC-4124) that the bank's own analysts could not fit to a documented typology.

sar.narrative: Customer C09904, holder of card C09904-K1, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-11-20 and 2016-11-20, 3 transaction(s) totalling $599.79 were identified as unauthorised on that card, the earliest being transaction 3473620 and the transaction that triggered review being 3473726 for $199.96. The activity was conducted through the online channel in billing region 536.0. The transactions originated from device profile 'rv:11.0 | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1200', which the issuer's identity record marks 'New' for this account. The activity matches no documented typology in the issuer's manual and is described in the accompanying case record. Closed investigation CC-3656 recorded confirmed fraud on comparable activity. The issuer assesses the probability of fraud at 0.91 on the evidence set out above. Total suspicious amount: $599.79.
